body:
OMG the Getaway Car bridge took under 30 seconds.

Taylor and Jack Antonoff were in the studio making reputation, her iPhone just happened to be recording, and the song's whole big turn arrives on camera in real time. you can actually watch it happen!!

Jack later told Rolling Stone it was the only time in all his hours in studios "that a camera was ever on when magic actually happened." that sentence lives in my head now 🖤

reputation turned 9 this week, and this is still my favorite thing about it. send this to whoever still screams that bridge in the car.

📸 Paolo Villanueva (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons
